description: Source file implementing ASN.1 message structures and serialization/deserialization methods for BCCH-BCH messages in 5G NR RRC, including packing, unpacking, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: bcch_bch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the BCCH-BCH message sequence containing a message field.

classes.name: bcch_bch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice type for different BCCH-BCH message types, currently supporting MIB and message class extension.

classes.name: mib_s
classes.description: Represents the MIB ASN.1 sequence with various configuration parameters.

classes.name: pdcch_cfg_sib1_s
classes.description: Represents the PDCCH-ConfigSIB1 ASN.1 sequence with control resource set and search space identifiers.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into a bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from a bit stream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the structure to JSON format.

methods.name: set_mib
methods.description: Sets the message type to MIB.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to message class extension.
